US-1: register a new book with a unique ISBN, title, and author

Rol: Librarian

BDD · 3 escenario(s)
Como Librarian,
Quiero register a new book with a unique ISBN, title, and author,
Para maintain an accurate and up-to-date library catalog.
Escenario: AC-1.1
DADO a librarian with valid book details (ISBN, title, author)
CUANDO they submit a request to register the book
ENTONCES the system creates the book and returns HTTP 201 with the created book details
Escenario: AC-1.2
DADO a book with an ISBN that already exists in the system
CUANDO the librarian attempts to register it
ENTONCES the system rejects the request and returns HTTP 400 with an error message indicating duplicate ISBN
Escenario: AC-1.3
DADO a book with an empty title
CUANDO the librarian attempts to register it
ENTONCES the system rejects the request and returns HTTP 400 with an error message indicating title cannot be empty
3 escenario(s) de prueba
US-2: update the title of an existing book identified by its ISBN

Rol: Librarian

BDD · 3 escenario(s)
Como Librarian,
Quiero update the title of an existing book identified by its ISBN,
Para correct or modify book information as needed.
Escenario: AC-2.1
DADO a book exists with a known ISBN
CUANDO the librarian updates the title with a valid new title
ENTONCES the system updates the title and returns HTTP 200 with the updated book details
Escenario: AC-2.2
DADO a book does not exist for a given ISBN
CUANDO the librarian attempts to update its title
ENTONCES the system returns HTTP 404 with an error message indicating the book was not found
Escenario: AC-2.3
DADO a book exists with a known ISBN
CUANDO the librarian attempts to update the title to an empty string
ENTONCES the system returns HTTP 400 with an error message indicating title cannot be empty
3 escenario(s) de prueba
US-3: retrieve book details by its ISBN

Rol: Library Patron

BDD · 2 escenario(s)
Como Library Patron,
Quiero retrieve book details by its ISBN,
Para find information about a specific book in the library.
Escenario: AC-3.1
DADO a book exists with a specific ISBN
CUANDO the patron requests the book by ISBN
ENTONCES the system returns HTTP 200 with the book details
Escenario: AC-3.2
DADO no book exists with a specific ISBN
CUANDO the patron requests the book by ISBN
ENTONCES the system returns HTTP 404 with an error message indicating the book was not found
2 escenario(s) de prueba
US-4: delete a book from the library catalog by its ISBN

Rol: Librarian

BDD · 2 escenario(s)
Como Librarian,
Quiero delete a book from the library catalog by its ISBN,
Para remove outdated or lost books from the system.
Escenario: AC-4.1
DADO a book exists with a specific ISBN
CUANDO the librarian deletes the book by ISBN
ENTONCES the system removes the book and returns HTTP 204 No Content
Escenario: AC-4.2
DADO no book exists with a specific ISBN
CUANDO the librarian attempts to delete it
ENTONCES the system returns HTTP 404 with an error message indicating the book was not found
2 escenario(s) de prueba
